prompt: Create a vertical fine-art double-exposure portrait of a young South Asian woman in a romantic watercolor collage style. The main subject stands slightly right of center, facing the viewer with a gentle closed-mouth smile, long dark wavy hair, soft natural makeup, and one hand raised near her ear. She wears a deep maroon and black sari with ornate red embroidered borders, large silver jhumka earrings, stacked bangles, and a delicate black-bead necklace. Behind her, place a large translucent left-facing side-profile portrait of the same woman on the left side, blended softly into the background. Fill the upper center and right with dark silhouettes of pine trees and woodland foliage, merging into her hair and the profile portrait. Use an aged cream parchment background with loose watercolor washes, ink splatters, botanical stems, autumn leaves, and earthy tones of sepia, olive, rust, burgundy, charcoal, and muted gold. Include exactly 4 butterflies: one near the upper right corner, one dark butterfly on the mid-right among branches, one pale butterfly near the lower left, and one subtle dark butterfly near the lower center. The composition should feel dreamy, elegant, and painterly, with realistic facial detail on the main figure but transparent watercolor edges, no text, no watermark, no frame. Lighting is soft and flattering, with high detail in the face, sari embroidery, jewelry, and layered forest textures.
